slides.title: Set up the pilot's phone
slides.html: Open Drones and its Settings tab, tap Pilot and set your team under Unit with Pick. Tap ‹ to open the pilot page.

slides.title: Wait for the flight
slides.html: The page waits for a flight from your team and shows the accepted strike under it. The screen stays on.

slides.title: No drone position yet
slides.html: Once your team takes off, the page shows the strike and its target. Until your team picks the drone track it says No drone position.

slides.title: Fly by the numbers
slides.html: Fly by the big bearing and the arrow, drawn North up, with Distance and Flight left under them. The bottom line says how far the drone is from the edge of the corridor it must stay in, left or right as it faces the target.

slides.title: See the map
slides.html: The pilot page's Map button shows the target here. Tap Drones to come back.
